/* Block 1: Defer render-blocking app CSS (SAM Shipping Protection).
   Shopify injects this synchronously; we replace each <link> with a
   non-blocking equivalent. MutationObserver catches late-injected CSS too
   (Smile.io ships theirs via JS post-DOMContentLoaded). */
(function(){
  var dp=['sam-shipping'];
  function deferLink(el){
    if(el.getAttribute('data-deferred'))return;
    var href=el.href, parent=el.parentNode;
    parent.removeChild(el);
    var nl=document.createElement('link');
    nl.rel='stylesheet'; nl.href=href; nl.media='print';
    nl.setAttribute('data-deferred','1');
    nl.onload=function(){this.media='all';};
    parent.appendChild(nl);
  }
  function matchesPattern(href){
    for(var j=0;j < dp.length;j++){if(href.indexOf(dp[j])!==-1)return true;}
    return false;
  }
  var existing=document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]');
  for(var i=0;i < existing.length;i++){
    if(existing[i].href&&matchesPattern(existing[i].href))deferLink(existing[i]);
  }
  var obs=new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    muts.forEach(function(m){
      m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){
        if(n.nodeType===1&&n.tagName==='LINK'&&n.rel==='stylesheet'&&n.href&&matchesPattern(n.href))deferLink(n);
      });
    });
  });
  obs.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  setTimeout(function(){obs.disconnect();},10000);
})();
</script>

        if(node.tagName==='SCRIPT'&&node.src&&node.src.indexOf('fastbundle')!==-1){

})();

(function(){
  var dp=['googletagmanager','gtag/js','connect.facebook','fbevents','bat.bing'];
  /* Klaviyo bootstrap — matched on src ONLY, so the app embed's inline
     _learnq/klaviyo queue declarations are never intercepted. */
  var kp=['static.klaviyo.com/onsite','static-tracking.klaviyo.com/onsite'];
  var klaviyoOk=true;
  /* Meta pixel — a subset of dp. Where metaOk is false the injection is
     dropped instead of deferred (see the Meta pixel gate above). */
  var mp=['connect.facebook','fbevents'];
  var metaOk=false;
  var bp=['portable-wallets','shopify_pay','accelerated-checkout'];
  var deferred=[];
  /* Klaviyo's held chunks (see klObs below) re-inject at idle AFTER the load
     event; rehydrate()'s own idle callback can fire before DOMContentLoaded on
     a fast connection, which would put the 268 KB bundle back on the critical path. */
  var klHeld=[];
  function matches(s,list){
    if(!s)return false;
    for(var i=0;i < list.length;i++){if(s.indexOf(list[i])!==-1)return true;}
    return false;
  }
  /* Belt and braces: never let this observer remove Klaviyo's own CSS. */
  function isKlaviyoAsset(n){
    var h=n.getAttribute&&n.getAttribute('href');
    if(h&&h.indexOf('klaviyo')!==-1)return true;
    if(n.href&&String(n.href).indexOf('klaviyo')!==-1)return true;
    if(n.id&&n.id.indexOf('klaviyo')!==-1)return true;
    return false;
  }
  var obs=new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    muts.forEach(function(m){
      m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){
        if(n.nodeType!==1)return;
        if((n.tagName==='LINK'||n.tagName==='STYLE')&&isKlaviyoAsset(n))return;
        if(bp.length){
          if(n.tagName==='SCRIPT'){
            var attr=n.getAttribute('data-source-attribution')||'';
            if(attr.indexOf('dynamic_checkout')!==-1){
              n.type='text/plain';
              if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
              return;
            }
            if(n.src&&matches(n.src,bp)){
              n.type='text/plain';
              if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
              return;
            }
          }
          if(n.tagName==='LINK'&&n.href&&matches(n.href,bp)){
            if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
            return;
          }
          if(n.tagName==='STYLE'&&n.id&&n.id.indexOf('accelerated-checkout')!==-1){
            if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
            return;
          }
          if(n.tagName&&n.tagName.toLowerCase().indexOf('shopify-accelerated-checkout')!==-1){
            if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
            return;
          }
        }
        if(n.tagName==='SCRIPT'){
          if(n.src&&matches(n.src,kp))return; /* klObs below owns Klaviyo */
          if(n.src&&matches(n.src,dp)){
            if(metaOk||!matches(n.src,mp))deferred.push({src:n.src,a:n.async});
            n.type='text/plain';
            if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
            return;
          }
          if(!n.src&&n.textContent&&matches(n.textContent,dp)){
            if(metaOk||!matches(n.textContent,mp))deferred.push({t:n.textContent});
            n.type='text/plain';
            if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
          }
        }
        if(n.tagName==='LINK'&&n.href&&matches(n.href,dp)){
          if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
        }
      });
    });
  });
  obs.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  /* Klaviyo has its own SCRIPT-only observer (Klaviyo's link/style elements
     are never touched). Measured 2026-09-09: the parser-inserted klaviyo.js
     bootstrap still executes after this detaches it (it defines
     window.klaviyo), but a detached bootstrap cannot locate its own tag and
     never loads the onsite bundle chunks — its chunk loading is not DOM
     script insertion an observer could catch. So: detach the bootstrap the
     moment it appears; on allowed pages re-inject a connected copy at idle
     after the load event (that copy loads the bundle and the form); on
     blocked pages never re-inject, and keep watching for the life of the
     page so a late duplicate (e.g. from a pixel) is detached too. */
  /* On blocked templates the Meta library must never be FETCHED: detaching
     a script element after insertion does not cancel its fetch (measured 2026-09-09 —
     fbevents.js still loaded and ran). Elevar's loader assigns the src on a
     script it creates, so refuse that assignment here: the URL is parked in
     data-hcs-blocked-src and the element never requests anything. The
     observer below stays as the second line for any other insertion path. */
  if(!metaOk){
    try{
      var srcDesc=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLScriptElement.prototype,'src');
      if(srcDesc&&srcDesc.set){
        Object.defineProperty(HTMLScriptElement.prototype,'src',{
          configurable:true,enumerable:srcDesc.enumerable,
          get:srcDesc.get,
          set:function(v){
            if(matches(String(v),mp)){this.setAttribute('data-hcs-blocked-src',String(v));return;}
            srcDesc.set.call(this,v);
          }
        });
      }
      var setAttr=Element.prototype.setAttribute;
      Element.prototype.setAttribute=function(k,v){
        if(this.tagName==='SCRIPT'&&String(k).toLowerCase()==='src'&&matches(String(v),mp)){
          return setAttr.call(this,'data-hcs-blocked-src',String(v));
        }
        return setAttr.call(this,k,v);
      };
    }catch(e){}
  }
  /* Meta hold outlives rehydrate() on blocked templates: Elevar can inject
     the pixel after the shared observer has disconnected. SCRIPT only. */
  if(!metaOk&&window.MutationObserver){
    new MutationObserver(function(muts){
      muts.forEach(function(m){
        m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){
          if(n.nodeType!==1||n.tagName!=='SCRIPT')return;
          var hit=(n.src&&matches(n.src,mp))||(!n.src&&n.textContent&&matches(n.textContent,mp));
          if(!hit)return;
          n.type='text/plain';
          if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
        });
      });
    }).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  }
  var klReleased=false;
  var klObs=new MutationObserver(function(muts){
    muts.forEach(function(m){
      m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){
        if(n.nodeType!==1||n.tagName!=='SCRIPT'||!n.src||!matches(n.src,kp))return;
        if(klaviyoOk&&!klReleased&&klHeld.indexOf(n.src)===-1)klHeld.push(n.src);
        n.type='text/plain';
        if(n.parentNode)n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
      });
    });
  });
  klObs.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  function injectKl(){
    klReleased=true;
    klObs.disconnect();
    var host=document.body||document.head||document.documentElement;
    for(var k=0;k < klHeld.length;k++){
      var ks=document.createElement('script');
      ks.src=klHeld[k];ks.async=true;
      host.appendChild(ks);
    }
    klHeld=[];
  }
  function klIdle(){
    if(window.requestIdleCallback){window.requestIdleCallback(injectKl,{timeout:5000});}
    else{setTimeout(injectKl,2000);}
  }
  if(klaviyoOk){
    if(document.readyState==='complete'){klIdle();}
    else{window.addEventListener('load',klIdle,{once:true});}
  }document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
    var dc=document.querySelectorAll('shopify-accelerated-checkout,shopify-accelerated-checkout-cart,[id*="accelerated-checkout"],[data-shopify="dynamic-checkout-cart"],.dynamic-checkout__content');
    for(var k=0;k < dc.length;k++){dc[k].parentNode.removeChild(dc[k]);}
    var dcMeta=document.querySelector('#shopify-digital-wallet');
    if(dcMeta)dcMeta.parentNode.removeChild(dcMeta);
  });function rehydrate(){
    /* Disconnect FIRST so anything re-injected below can add its own
       link/style elements with nothing watching (klObs only ever looks at SCRIPT). */
    obs.disconnect();
    var host=document.body||document.head||document.documentElement;
    for(var i=0;i < deferred.length;i++){
      var s=document.createElement('script');
      if(deferred[i].src){s.src=deferred[i].src;s.async=true;}
      else if(deferred[i].t){s.textContent=deferred[i].t;}
      host.appendChild(s);
    }
  }
  if(window.requestIdleCallback){
    window.requestIdleCallback(rehydrate,{timeout:5000});
  } else {
    setTimeout(rehydrate,4000);
  }
})();
</script>

      window.Shopify = window.Shopify || {};

      Shopify.money_format = "${{amount}}";

      Shopify.formatMoney = function(cents, format) {
        if (typeof cents === 'string') {
          cents = cents.replace('.', '');
        }
        cents = parseInt(cents, 10);

        let value = '';
        
        const placeholderRegex = /{{\s*(\w+)\s*}}/;
        
        const formatString = format || this.money_format;

        function defaultOption(opt, def) {
          return (typeof opt === 'undefined' ? def : opt);
        }

        function formatWithDelimiters(number, precision, thousands, decimal) {
          precision = defaultOption(precision, 2);
          thousands = defaultOption(thousands, ',');
          decimal = defaultOption(decimal, '.');

          if (isNaN(number) || number == null) return '0';

          number = (number / 100).toFixed(precision);

          const parts = number.split('.'),
                dollars = parts[0].replace(/(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '$1' + thousands),
                centsPart = parts[1] ? (decimal + parts[1]) : '';

          return dollars + centsPart;
        }

        const match = formatString.match(placeholderRegex);
        if (!match || !match[1]) return formatString;

        switch (match[1]) {
          case 'amount':
            value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2);
            break;
          case 'amount_no_decimals':
            value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0);
            break;
          case 'amount_with_comma_separator':
            value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2, '.', ',');
            break;
          case 'amount_no_decimals_with_comma_separator':
            value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 0, '.', ',');
            break;
          default:
            value = formatWithDelimiters(cents, 2);
        }

        return formatString.replace(placeholderRegex, value);
      };

(function () {
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Get theme settings
  const enableBoxShadow = true;
  const shadowIntensity = 1;
  const enableGradient = false;
  const enableGradientShine = false;

  // If neither effect is enabled, exit early
  if (!enableBoxShadow && !enableGradient) {
    return;
  }

  // Define button selectors that should receive enhanced effects
  const buttonSelectors = [
    '.button-global-style',
    '.use-global-button-styling',
    '.button',
    '.btn',
    'button[type="submit"]',
    'input[type="submit"]',
    '.product-form__submit',
    '.shop-add-to-cart-button',
    '.cart__checkout-button',
    '.button--primary',
    '.claim-button',
    '.field__button',
    '.theme-button',
    '.guarantee-section__cta',
    '.custom-hero__button',
    '.rich-text-button'
  ];

  // Function to apply effects to buttons
  function applyButtonEffects() {
    buttonSelectors.forEach(selector => {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
      buttons.forEach(button => {
        // Skip buttons that explicitly opt out or cart remove buttons.
        // Cart remove buttons should remain simple and subtle.
        if (button.classList.contains('button-section-override') ||
           button.classList.contains('no-enhanced-effects') ||
           button.classList.contains('cart-remove-button') ||
           button.classList.contains('button--tertiary') ||
           button.classList.contains('disable-global-button-styling')) {
          return;
        }

        // Apply box shadow effect if enabled
        if (enableBoxShadow) {
          button.classList.add('button-box-shadow');
          button.classList.add(`intensity-${shadowIntensity}`);
        }

    <script>

          var drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
          if (drawer && typeof drawer.close === 'function') drawer.close();

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
          if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
          var drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer.active, cart-drawer.is-open, cart-drawer[open]');
          if (!drawer) drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
          if (drawer && typeof drawer.close === 'function') drawer.close();
        });

        // ── Upsell carousel arrow controls ─────────────────────────
        // Bound once at section render. Survives cart-drawer re-renders
        // because the document-level click delegation persists; per-
        // scroller scroll listeners are re-attached via the cartUpdate
        // pub/sub below.
        function hcsUpsellGetScroller(btn) {
          var wrap = btn.closest('.hcs-upsell');
          return wrap ? wrap.querySelector('[data-hcs-upsell-scroller]') : null;
        }
        function hcsUpsellUpdateArrows(scroller) {
          var wrap = scroller.closest('.hcs-upsell');
          if (!wrap) return;
          var prev = wrap.querySelector('[data-hcs-upsell-arrow="prev"]');
          var next = wrap.querySelector('[data-hcs-upsell-arrow="next"]');
          var atStart = scroller.scrollLeft <= 2;
          var atEnd = scroller.scrollLeft + scroller.clientWidth >= scroller.scrollWidth - 2;
          if (prev) prev.disabled = atStart;
          if (next) next.disabled = atEnd;
        }
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          var btn = e.target.closest('[data-hcs-upsell-arrow]');
          if (!btn) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          var scroller = hcsUpsellGetScroller(btn);
          if (!scroller) return;
          var card = scroller.querySelector('.hcs-upsell__card');
          var step = card ? card.getBoundingClientRect().width + 10 : 200;
          var dir = btn.getAttribute('data-hcs-upsell-arrow') === 'next' ? 1 : -1;
          scroller.scrollBy({ left: step * dir, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
        function hcsUpsellBindScrollers() {
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-hcs-upsell-scroller]').forEach(function (el) {
            if (el.__hcsBound) return;
            el.__hcsBound = true;
            el.addEventListener('scroll', function () { hcsUpsellUpdateArrows(el); });
            hcsUpsellUpdateArrows(el);
          });
        }
        hcsUpsellBindScrollers();
        setTimeout(hcsUpsellBindScrollers, 200);
        if (window.subscribe && window.PUB_SUB_EVENTS && window.PUB_SUB_EVENTS.cartUpdate) {
          window.subscribe(window.PUB_SUB_EVENTS.cartUpdate, function () {
            setTimeout(hcsUpsellBindScrollers, 50);

        // ── Upsell Add-to-cart button ──────────────────────────────
        // Document-delegated click handler. Cart drawer re-renders on
        // every cart update, so a per-button listener would be lost;
        // delegating off `document` survives swaps.
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

            });

<script>
  (function () {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('HcsAcctMenu');
    if (!wrap) return;
    var trigger = wrap.querySelector('[data-hcs-acct-trigger]');
    var touchMode = window.matchMedia('(hover: none)');

    function isOpen() {
      return wrap.classList.contains('hcs-acct--open');
    }

    function setOpen(open) {
      wrap.classList.toggle('hcs-acct--open', open);
      trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }

    trigger.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (!touchMode.matches) return; /* desktop: icon click navigates to account home */
      event.preventDefault();
      setOpen(!isOpen());
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (isOpen() && !wrap.contains(event.target)) setOpen(false);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
      if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
      if (isOpen()) {
        setOpen(false);
        trigger.focus();
      } else if (wrap.contains(document.activeElement)) {
        /* desktop :focus-within open — blur closes it */
        document.activeElement.blur();
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<div class="hgcs-history-wrapper">

  <div class="hgcs-history-header">
    <h1>The Capital of Capsaicin</h1>
    <div class="subtitle">Why a tiny village in the Rio Grande Valley became the center of the culinary world.</div>
  </div>

  <p><span class="hgcs-drop-cap">T</span>here is a saying in the Rio Grande Valley: <em>"You can steal the seed, but you can't steal the soil."</em></p>

  <p>Every year, millions of pounds of green chile are sold around the world. But if you ask any serious chef, they will tell you that unless it was grown in the specific micro-climate of the Hatch Valley, it is just a pepper. It isn't Hatch.</p>
  
  <p>At the Hatch Green Chile Store, we don't just sell a product; we are stewards of a legacy that dates back over a century. To understand the flavor, you have to understand the place. This is the story of how a flood, a scientist, and a law created the "Napa Valley of Spice." That legacy is as much about our deep-red <a href="/pages/new-mexico-red-chile" style="color:#9E2B25;">New Mexico red chile</a> as the famous green.</p>

  <h2 class="hgcs-section-title">1. The Terroir: Why Here?</h2>
  <p>In winemaking, the French use the word <em>terroir</em> to describe how the environment affects the flavor of the grape. Hatch Chile has a terroir that cannot be replicated in a greenhouse or a field in California.</p>

  <div class="hgcs-terroir-box">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0; text-align:center;">The "Goldilocks" Geography</h3>
    <p>Hatch, New Mexico sits at an elevation of roughly <strong>4,058 feet</strong>. This high desert environment creates a unique stress test for the plant:</p>
    <div class="hgcs-terroir-grid">
      <div class="hgcs-terroir-item">
        <h4>☀️ Scorch & Cool Cycle</h4>
        <p>Hatch experiences intensely hot days (95°F+) followed by cool nights (60°F). This <strong>Diurnal Shift</strong> signals the plant to produce more capsaicin (heat) as a defense mechanism, while the cool nights lock in the sugars.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hgcs-terroir-item">
        <h4>💧 The Rio Grande</h4>
        <p>The nutrient-rich irrigation water from the Rio Grande deposits minerals from the northern mountains into the sandy loam soil, creating a distinct earthy flavor profile that "imitator" peppers lack.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h2 class="hgcs-section-title">2. The Godfather: Dr. Fabian Garcia</h2>
  <p>Before 1900, chiles in New Mexico were unpredictable. One pod might be mild, the next might blow your head off. They were also small, gnarled, and difficult to peel.</p>
  
  <div class="hgcs-timeline-item">
    <span class="hgcs-year">1894</span>
    <strong>The Project Begins</strong><br>
    Dr. Fabian Garcia at New Mexico A&M (now NMSU) begins the first scientific chile improvement program in the world. His goal: a larger, smoother pepper that could be roasted and peeled easily.
  </div>

  <div class="hgcs-timeline-item">
    <span class="hgcs-year">1913</span>
    <strong>New Mexico No. 9</strong><br>
    Dr. Garcia releases "New Mexico No. 9." This is the great-grandfather of all modern Hatch chile. It standardized the flavor and the "meaty" wall texture we love today.
  </div>
  
  <div class="hgcs-timeline-item">
    <span class="hgcs-year">1921</span>
    <strong>The Great Flood</strong><br>
    A massive flood devastated the valley, wiping out the fields. However, as the waters receded, they left behind layers of rich sediment. This "reset" of the soil quality is often cited as the geological turning point that supercharged the valley's agriculture.
  </div>

  <div class="hgcs-timeline-item">
    <span class="hgcs-year">1975</span>
    <strong>The Big Jim</strong><br>
    Dr. Roy Nakayama releases the "Big Jim" cultivar, named after Hatch rancher Jim Lytle. It holds the record for the largest chile pod ever grown, revolutionizing the <em>Chile Relleno</em> industry.
  </div>

  <blockquote class="hgcs-quote">
    "Hatch isn't just a town. It's an ecosystem of heritage seeds, river water, and multi-generational farming families."
  </blockquote>

  <h2 class="hgcs-section-title">3. The Law: Protecting the Name</h2>
  <p>Because the flavor of Hatch chile is so valuable, imposters have tried to capitalize on it for decades. Foreign growers would ship generic peppers and slap a "Hatch" sticker on them.</p>

  <div class="hgcs-law-box">
    <h3>⚖️ The New Mexico Chile Advertising Act</h3>
    <p>New Mexico enacted the <strong>New Mexico Chile Advertising Act</strong> in 2011 (<a href="https://www.nmlegis.gov/sessions/11%20regular/final/HB0485.pdf" rel="nofollow" style="color:#CC7520;text-decoration:underline;">House Bill 485, Laws 2011, Chapter 57</a>), then amended it in 2013 (<a href="https://www.nmlegis.gov/Sessions/13%20Regular/final/HB0238.pdf" rel="nofollow" style="color:#CC7520;text-decoration:underline;">House Bill 238</a>). It regulates advertising chile as New Mexico-grown; Hatch Valley origin is a more specific origin claim.</p>
    <p><strong>The Warning:</strong> Many "souvenir brands" blend their chile with cheaper imports. At Hatch Green Chile Store, our family's fields are the source. We don't import. We roast and ship from the Valley. When you buy from us, you are tasting the 87937 zip code.</p>
  </div>

  <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 60px; padding: 50px; background: #FFFDF9; border-top: 1px solid #ddd;">
    <h3 style="margin-top: 0; font-family: var(--font-heading-family); text-transform: uppercase;">Taste the History</h3>
    <p style="margin-bottom: 30px;">Don't settle for generic "Green Chile." Experience the terroir of the Hatch Valley.</p>
    <a href="/products/roasted" style="background-color: #CC7520; color: white; padding: 18px 35px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-heading-family); letter-spacing: 1px;">Shop Authentic Hatch Chile</a>
  </div>

<div style="margin-top: 60px; border-top: 4px solid #CC7520; padding-top: 40px;">
    <h2 class="hgcs-section-title">The Pilgrimage: Hatch Chile Festival</h2>
    <p>Every Labor Day weekend, thousands of "chileheads" descend on our tiny village for the annual <strong>Hatch Chile Festival</strong>. It is a celebration of the harvest, the heritage, and the heat.</p>
    
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 30px;">
      <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 300px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 25px; border-radius: 8px;">
        <h3 style="margin-top: 0; color:#A85A14;">📅 Visiting in Person?</h3>
        <ul style="list-style: none; padding: 0; line-height: 1.8;">
          <li><strong>When:</strong> Labor Day Weekend (Every Year)</li>
          <li><strong>Where:</strong> Hatch, New Mexico (Exit 41 off I-25)</li>
          <li><strong>The Vibe:</strong> Roasters spinning, music playing, and the smell of roasting chile filling the entire valley.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 300px; background: #EAF1E6; border: 1px solid #4A6B42; padding: 25px; border-radius: 8px;">
        <h3 style="margin-top: 0; color: #3A5435;">✈️ Can't Make the Drive?</h3>
        <p>You don't have to battle the crowds, the heat, or the TSA restrictions. We roast the same festival-quality chile and ship it frozen to your door.</p>
        <p><strong>Skip the flight. Get the bite.</strong></p>
        <a href="/products/roasted" style="background-color: #3A5435; color: white; padding: 10px 20px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; display: inline-block; margin-top: 10px;">Order Your Personal Festival Batch →</a>
        <p style="margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;color:#5C4A3D;">Coming to the festival, or just passing through? See <a href="/blogs/hatch/see">what to see in Hatch, NM</a>.</p>
